# DSH Studio v0.9.20

## New features

- Add a local presentation workspace for text, shapes, tables and charts, with object selection, drag/keyboard movement, undo/redo, three original starter templates, bounded atomic source storage and stale-revision protection.
- Add static PNG, JPEG and WebP pictures from local files or session-authorized conversation previews. Support contain, crop and stretch modes, descriptions and transactional resource/document validation while keeping a later slide selection stable.
- Generate editable PPTX files in a cancellable background worker and save them atomically through the native picker. Save As creates independent document, slide and object identities only after persistence succeeds.
- Preserve bounded attachment metadata in offline sessions and exports. Add authenticated, session-scoped image and digest-verified UTF-8 text previews, local PDF reading, and atomic saving of verified original attachments.
- Add reviewed version history for upgrades, reinstalls and supported downgrades, with cancellable signed downloads and a verifiable website metadata fallback. RPM downgrade remains unavailable in the built-in updater.

## Changes and security

- Unify all pages on shared 24/28/32/40 px buttons, icon buttons, fields, selectors and segmented controls, with consistent typography, spacing, radii, badges and dialogs. Refresh the plugin market, sessions, presentations, settings, remote, terminal and titlebar.
- Bind a release to one canonical stable tag, its exact commit and one unpublished draft. Require all five application, SDK and native version sources to agree; reject partial-platform rebuilds, older versions replacing the latest channel, wrong-commit publication and mutation of a public release.
- Clear stale assets only from the matching draft, rebuild every platform from one commit, and select the previous stable release by semantic version rather than creation order.
- Keep Tauri JavaScript packages on patch-only ranges matching the native crate minor line, then verify seven resolved guest/native pairs before packaging.
- Keep attachment content behind current-session authorization and strict count, name, size, MIME, UTF-8 and SHA-256 bounds. Strip local paths/control characters and escape attachment metadata in HTML exports.
- Validate PPTX ZIP layout, encryption, expanded sizes and checksums plus XML encoding, namespaces, content types and ordered slide relationships. Reject DTDs, external document parts and missing/duplicate slides; arbitrary PPTX import is not included.
- Coordinate quit, update installation and renderer recovery across all presentation windows so dirty, busy or unresponsive editors block the operation and approved windows remain locked through native work and reload.
- Authenticate the remote gateway with the current Harness before admitting devices, retain upstream credentials only in memory, and cancel pending or live streams on revocation, shutdown or poisoned-auth recovery.

## Fixes and polish

- Replace native presentation fieldset borders and bright input outlines, fix collapsed-sidebar badge overflow, enlarge About path targets and respect reduced motion for loading shimmer.
- Reduce the default window from 1360×880 to 1100×740 while retaining user-adjusted size and position.
- Qualify the exact Full/Offline staged runtime with its selected Node before activation; failed or legacy-journal recovery keeps the current runtime.
- Show update-check progress and completion time, propagate joined manual-check failures, cap a complete native check at 30 seconds, and enforce install/probe deadlines even while child output continues.
- Fix cancellable remote opening, stale replies, post-pairing authorization, select-label punctuation and narrow titlebar overlap. Bound and redact forwarded startup diagnostics.
- Read current and legacy tool results without model-only replacement duplicates, choose the latest numeric session-log generation, and keep Cordis theme/file-preview listeners alive for their real effect lifetime.
- Move recursive XML tree parsing to a bounded dedicated stack while retaining input-depth limits.
- Share one deterministic contract for all eight desktop pages: Runtime, Terminal, Sessions, Plugins, Remote, Presentations, About and Settings.

## Installation

- Upgrade from `v0.9.19` or use reviewed version history for a supported target. Full / Offline verifies its packaged runtime through a real boot before promotion; Lite provisions the runtime on demand.
- The release matrix remains Windows x64, Linux x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel and macOS Universal. Extract the complete Windows portable ZIP and keep `dist/` beside the executable. Updater signatures are not OS publisher signatures or proof of external repository admission.
- Exact-version plugin compatibility remains enforced; the application does not delete user profiles, plugins or sessions to bypass incompatibility.

## Verification

- The final tagged workflow gates publication on frontend coverage, Rust tests, npm semver differential checks, packaging contracts, production builds, strict Clippy, lint, public command/ACL, Tauri pairing, bilingual documentation, website and static accessibility checks.
- Every platform is built from one commit. Packaged applications, updater signatures and the complete artifact inventory are checked before SHA256SUMS and public publication; Windows uses a GUI-subsystem Release build.
- The user confirmed verification of the current changes. Automated route contracts are not represented as native click-through acceptance or a zero-defect claim. Physical macOS/Linux devices, Narrator, paid providers and external-credential workflows are outside the local Windows evidence.
